name: Custom Shape Suncatcher Night Light Box
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality wood and acrylic.
    - Multi-layer 3D construction includes:
                   +) Layer 1 (Back Layer): Wooden 3mm – 2-sided printing.
                   +) Layer 2: Acrylic 2mm – 1-sided printing.
                   +) Layer 3 (Front Layer): Wooden 3mm – 1-sided printing.
    - Multiple acrylic spacers (1.5 x 1.5 cm) create depth between layers.
    - LED light strip installed on the bottom wooden layer.
    - Precision laser-cut for clean edges and fine details.
    - Sturdy and durable structure.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Overall size: 8 x 8 in ~ 20.32 x 20.32 cm.
    - Total thickness: 0.9 in ~ 2.3 cm.
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.  Multiple acrylic spacer sizes are fixed and cannot be changed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Advanced UV printing technology.
    - Sharp, vibrant, and fade-resistant colors.
    - Features double-sided printing on the wooden layer 1, single-sided printing on the layer 2 and layer 3.

 

  • LED Lighting Features:
    - Built-in LED light strip inside the box.
    - Creates a warm stained-glass suncatcher effect when illuminated.
    - USB powered.
    - Built-in switch for monochrome lighting.
    - Soft ambient glow enhances the layered artwork.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Decorative tabletop or shelf display.
    - Functions as both a night light and a decorative art piece.
    - Layered design creates a stained-glass visual effect.
    - Ideal for bedrooms, living rooms, or workspaces.
    - Personalized design for family themes, Father’s Day, or special occasions.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - Meaningful personalized gift for Mom, Dad, family members, or loved ones.
    - Ideal for Mother's Day, Father’s Day, birthdays, anniversaries, and holidays.
    - A unique keepsake combining woodcraft and lighting art.
    - A sentimental decorative piece that lights up special memories 🎁.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1xCustom Shape Suncatcher Night Light Box

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.1-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
